POPULATION EFFECTS: Treatment effect was consistent across most subgroups, with notable exceptions being patients ≥70 years (HR 1.03) and those with 0% EGFR expression, suggesting mechanism-dependent efficacy. 5. CONFOUNDERS: No major trial design issues - adequate sample size (n=1093), appropriate comparator, and reasonable effect size for oncology setting.
